content_sections.heading: About ACTREC
content_sections.text: ACTREC is located at Kharghar, Navi Mumbai, and is part of the Tata Memorial Centre. The notice describes it as a grant-in-aid institution of the Department of Atomic Energy, Government of India. The post is on a research project studying why immune checkpoint blockade immunotherapies fail in oral cancer and what alternatives exist for Indian patients.

content_sections.heading: ACTREC Project Technical Support III Vacancy Details 2026
ACTREC Project Technical Support III Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: The age limit is 30 years. The notice prints no cut-off date for counting age. Qualification (essential): M.Sc. (Life Sciences) or equivalent with minimum 60% marks in the qualifying exam. Experience (essential): at least 1 year of wet lab experience and direct experience with murine cancer models. An M.Sc. degree of one-year duration will not be considered. The selected candidate has to join at the earliest, so result-awaited candidates are not eligible to apply. Candidates should check the official notification for any further eligibility details.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The engagement is on the project for six months and is extendable. The work progress of the candidate will be monitored, and an extension may be given after six months. The pay is a consolidated Rs. 36,400 per month, made up of Rs. 28,000 plus 30% HRA. Place of work: ACTREC, Kharghar, Navi Mumbai.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ACTREC Project Technical Support III Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Attend the walk-in interview on Tuesday, 17 November 2026 at Meeting Room I, Khanolkar Shodhika, 3rd Floor, ACTREC, Kharghar, Navi Mumbai - 410210. Report between 10.00 a.m. and 10.30 a.m. Carry the following documents: Recent CV Passport size photograph Original and xerox copies of educational qualification certificates Original and xerox copies of work experience certificates Aadhaar Card as ID proof (original and xerox)

faq.question: Q1. When and where is the ACTREC walk-in interview?
faq.answer: It is on Tuesday, 17 November 2026, at Meeting Room I, Khanolkar Shodhika, 3rd Floor, ACTREC, Kharghar, Navi Mumbai - 410210. Reporting is from 10.00 a.m. to 10.30 a.m.

faq.question: Q2. What is the salary for Project Technical Support III?
faq.answer: The consolidated salary is Rs. 36,400 per month, made up of Rs. 28,000 plus 30% HRA.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification and experience are required?
faq.answer: An M.Sc. (Life Sciences) or equivalent with at least 60% marks, and at least 1 year of wet lab experience with direct experience with murine cancer models.

faq.question: Q4. Is a one-year M.Sc. accepted?
faq.answer: No. An M.Sc. degree of one-year duration will not be considered.

faq.question: Q5. Can candidates awaiting their final result apply?
faq.answer: No. The selected candidate has to join at the earliest, so result-awaited candidates are not eligible.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit?
Q7. How long is the engagement?
faq.answer: Six months, extendable. The candidate's work progress will be monitored, and an extension may be given after six months.

faq.question: Q8. Which documents should I bring?
faq.answer: A recent CV, a passport size photograph, and original and xerox copies of educational and work experience certificates, plus the Aadhaar Card as ID proof.

faq.question: Q9. Which project is the post attached to?
faq.answer: The project studies the mechanisms behind the failure of immune checkpoint blockade immunotherapies in oral cancer and alternatives for Indian patients. The Principal Investigator is Dr. Subir Biswas.
